title: Web3 Hall of Famers
intro: Read the clue, pick the person, then hear their story. Every right answer adds them to your Hall of Fame wall. 50 people built, shaped and shook web3. How many can you collect?
wallLine: {n} of {total} collected. Play again to find the rest.
endLesson: Web3 was built by many people: coders, cryptographers, founders, investors, investigators and regulators. Knowing who did what helps you judge who to listen to.

note: Facts are public information as of November 2026. Roles change; tell us if something is out of date.
